instruction: Enable the video background cone in VLC preferences

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires navigating to VLC preferences (Tools > Preferences > Video) and enabling the background cone display setting. Uses existing check_qt_bgcone metric to verify the qt-bgcone setting is set to 1 in the VLC config file. Added postconfig to close VLC so config is saved.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator logic correctly verifies the instruction requirement to enable VLC background cone
Getter (get_vlc_config) correctly reads VLC config file from ~/.config/vlc/vlcrc
Metric (check_qt_bgcone) correctly checks qt-bgcone setting in config file
Expected value '1' correctly represents enabled state
Postconfig properly closes VLC to ensure config changes are written to disk
Metric correctly handles VLC's default behavior (qt-bgcone defaults to 1/enabled)
Data flow is correct: user action -> VLC close -> config write -> getter reads -> metric verifies
Complete coverage: evaluator checks exactly what the instruction requires
